semiconductor_relevance: Low — Harmonic Drive Systems specializes in motion control systems and gear reducers, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Harmonic Drive Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. focuses on providing motion control solutions, including harmonic drive speed reducers and precision planetary gear speed reducers. Their products are designed for high efficiency and precision, catering to various transmission systems but do not specifically target the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: The company operates as a wholly-owned sales subsidiary in China, focusing on sales and technical support for its products.
